OLD POLICY
Min length: 8, mixed case + digit + symbol
Rotation: every 90 days, no exceptions

NEW POLICY (NIST-aligned)
Min length: 12+
Composition rules: none required
Rotation: on evidence of compromise only
Screening: reject breached-password matches
caption: Length and breach screening replace complexity and the calendar.
